method: AI contextual review of two disclosure actions in all supported UI languages; not native-speaker certification.
scope: Show details / Hide details in the existing Chart details header. Reviewed the next-action meaning, concise phone-width wording and consistency with the maintained interface terminology guide. No game terms, identifiers or song aliases changed.
notes: Chinese expand/collapse and Korean view/collapse wording describe reversible disclosure actions. Japanese display/close refers to the details section, not navigation away from the card. English remains the canonical source text.
